headline: Mexico's GDP in Q3 was 0.9%; Sheinbaum says US did not take part in capture of Chapo Isidro
summary: Mexico's gross domestic product rose 0.9% in the third quarter, according to the latest national data. The figure is the headline economic release reported by El Economista.
why: GDP growth is a core gauge of Mexico's economic health, watched by investors in peso assets and Mexican sovereign debt. It also informs central bank policy.
original_headline: PIB de México en el III Trim. fue de 0.9%; Sheinbaum EU no participó en captura del Chapo Isidro
